title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'my_interfaces' and "cannot import name" for ROS 2 custom messages in rclpy: sourcing order, unlisted .msg files, ament_python packages and shadowing scripts, measured
excerpt: What each rclpy custom message import error meant on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: an unsourced or too-early-sourced workspace, .msg files missing from rosidl_generate_interfaces, wrong import lines, msg folders in ament_python packages, scripts that shadow the package, and member_of_group.
